'''Joe Fox Normal EBO''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Joe Fox]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-7736">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7736 Normal EBO], DeckTech (Joe "JoeCool144" Fox, 17 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7736/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7736/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018155850/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7736/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Fox]]
* '''Published:''' 17 June 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Normal EBO''

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}

== Original post ==

'''Normal EBO'''
* '''Author:''' Joe "JoeCool144" Fox
* '''Published:''' June 17, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' This is my first attemp at EBO.

=== Strategy ===

Just basic EBO. Set up EBO and drain in space. Use Ice Storm to keep em away. This is mostly Joe Alread's deck Idea with my modifications.
